C11:baseline:
{"decisions":[{"decision":"ANSWER_QA","order_id":null,"reason":"Pre-purchase product question answered from the SW-01 spec. Each person at 110 kg exceeds the 100 kg per-seat maximum, and the combined 330 kg exceeds the 300 kg total maximum."}],"reply":"Hello,

Thank you for your question about the 3-Seat Patio Swing Chair (SW-01).

According to the product specification, the maximum load is 100 kg (220 lb) per seat and 300 kg (660 lb) in total. Your brother and dad are each about 110 kg (240 lb), which is above the per-seat limit, and the three of you together would be about 330 kg (720 lb), which is above the total limit. For that reason, we do not recommend that the three of you sit on this swing chair together.

If you would like, I can help you check other options from our range. Please let me know if you have any other questions.

Kind regards,
Customer Service"}
C12:baseline:
{"decisions":[{"decision":"ANSWER_QA","order_id":null,"reason":"Pre-purchase product question about snow load; the GZ-05 spec states it is not rated for snow load and snow must be cleared promptly."}],"reply":"Hello,

Thank you for your question about the 3 x 4 m Aluminium Hardtop Gazebo (GZ-05).

The gazebo is not rated for snow load, so it is not designed to stay up all winter with snow on the roof. Snow should be cleared from the roof promptly and must not be allowed to accumulate. The gazebo also must be anchored to the ground.

If you expect heavy snowfall, please plan to remove snow after each storm, or consider dismantling and storing the gazebo indoors for the winter.

If you have any other questions about the product, please let us know and we will be happy to help.

Kind regards,
Customer Service"}
